PullRequest.Title: chat: simplify cloud sandbox input placeholder

## Summary

Use **“Chat with Copilot”** for cloud sandbox drafts, discovered sessions, and connected Copilot sessions instead of “Chat with Cloud” or the agent name with a sandbox-name suffix. Share the localized placeholder across these registration paths.

Keep the Agents window's new-session “Pitch your idea” prompt and other remote providers' placeholders unchanged. Extend regression coverage for draft/discovered registrations and the cloud-only Copilot override.

No linked issue; this is a requested UI-copy change. The branch is based on the latest fetched `main`.

## Validation

- `git diff origin/main...HEAD --check` — passed.
- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — blocked: missing `esbuild`.
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxConnectionCustomization.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/remoteAgentHostChatContribution.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHost.contribution.test.ts` — blocked: missing `eslint`.
- `npm run install-fast` — failed while building `@parcel/watcher`: DNS error `EAI_AGAIN www.electronjs.org` downloading Electron headers. Build and lint remain blocked after the restoration attempt.

Focused regression tests **not run** because client output could not be built:

```sh
./scripts/test.sh \
  --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/remoteAgentHost/test/browser/remoteAgentHost.contribution.test.ts \
  --grep 'offers one creation target|Remote Agent Host chat session contribution'
```

## Manual verification (not run)

1. Open a new Cloud draft in the editor: the empty input should show “Chat with Copilot”.
2. Open an existing cloud sandbox Copilot session in the editor or Agents window: the empty input should show “Chat with Copilot”, without the sandbox name.
3. Confirm that the Agents window's new-session input still shows “Pitch your idea” and ordinary remote sessions retain their existing placeholders.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create and open a new cloud-sandbox draft in the editor
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Feature enablement registers the draft session contribution once; binding the draft model looks up inputPlaceholder and updates the existing input editor option once. The added localized constant is evaluated at module initialization and the scalar metadata is available before rendering; no asynchronous work was added to the critical path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: At most the number of simultaneously opened chat widgets for UI consumption; registration cardinality is one draft type.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Registration is guarded by _discoveryRegistration and is single-instance. Widget binding is synchronous per opened widget; the changed field adds no queue, promise, listener, or concurrent operation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Warm enablement reuses the existing _discoveryRegistration, so no duplicate contribution is registered. The placeholder is a module-level shared string and requires no cache lookup, invalidation, or negative-cache behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the registration guard, service storage, widget lookup, and editor update call were traced directly; the diff only populates an existing scalar field.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual widget count varies, but the changed work remains one string reference per contribution and one existing editor-option update per model bind, not per keystroke or frame.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Before the PR, registration and widget binding already occurred and the widget generated a fallback placeholder; after the PR, the same path reads a supplied shared string instead. No boundary, extra event subscription, or scaling work is introduced.

Scenarios.Scenario: Discover cloud sandbox sessions and register one hidden session provider per environment
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Discovery obtains account state and session inventory, then _ensureProvider creates a provider once per unique sandbox address and registers its contribution. The added inputPlaceholder assignment is synchronous constant-time metadata construction after discovery; it does not delay or trigger discovery.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve the account, optionally start the session feed, and call listSessions for the cloud inventory; partial/failed task batches can receive one targeted retry.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One coalesced inventory call per discovery cycle, with a possible targeted retry for failed task IDs; provider registration occurs once per unique discovered sandbox address.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same account/session network discovery and provider creation ran before the PR; only the contribution object's scalar placeholder field was absent.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The inventory response must complete before newly discovered providers can be registered. The placeholder assignment occurs only after this pre-existing boundary returns.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of unique discovered sandbox addresses after deduplication; the change adds one shared string reference to each existing contribution object.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Inventory scans are explicitly serialized and coalesced through _discoveryInFlight/_discoveryQueued. Providers are deduplicated by _providerStores per address. The diff does not change this concurrency or scheduling.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold discovery performs the existing listSessions request and creates providers for unique addresses. Warm/refreshed discovery is serialized/coalesced, and _providerStores suppresses duplicate provider creation; the shared placeholder adds no cache entry or retained key.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the discovery call, coalescing lane, address deduplication, and _createProvider call were traced in repository code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number of environments and inventory latency vary by account, but neither controls additional expensive work from the diff; added CPU and retained state are constant per already-required provider registration.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The existing network boundary and per-environment provider creation are unchanged, while the diff adds only constant metadata with no serialization, allocation proportional to session history, or boundary fan-out.

Scenarios.Scenario: Connect to a remote cloud sandbox Copilot agent and register its chat session type
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A pre-existing remote connection/root-state update reaches _handleRootStateChange, which registers only providers not already present in connState.agents. The diff adds one address-prefix comparison, one provider equality check, and a shared placeholder reference during that registration.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Consume agent root-state updates from the existing AgentHost protocol connection.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing protocol stream per connected host; one contribution registration per newly observed provider, with subsequent root-state updates using the existing model update path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same connection, root-state subscription, authentication scheduling, and agent registration occurred before the PR; contribution registration omitted only inputPlaceholder.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The remote root state must already arrive before registration. The changed placeholder condition performs no protocol request and adds no round trip.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: New providers advertised across connected hosts after connState.agents deduplication, not every protocol message or chat input event.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Connection reconciliation is synchronous per connection event. Agent registration is deduplicated per provider in connState.agents; reconnect replacement is governed by existing connection lifecycle. No new tasks or concurrency burst are introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Initial root state is reused when already available, and connState.agents prevents re-registering an existing provider on later updates. The placeholder has no separate cache and shares the module-level localized string.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the root-state event path, per-provider deduplication, and changed registration expression were directly inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Hosts can advertise varying agent counts, but the added checks are constant per newly registered agent and only retain a shared string reference.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. No new IPC/network call, serialization, retained collection, or hot render/input work is introduced; the before/after difference is constant-time metadata assignment.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all five changed files and all diff pages. Traced draft registration, discovered-provider registration, connected-agent registration, service storage, and widget consumption. The PR adds a shared localized string and existing scalar contribution fields only; expensive discovery and protocol boundaries, deduplication, cache lifecycle, and concurrency are unchanged. No valid performance findings or regression-fix records.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
